findings.note: THE STAMP IS THE BATCH'S BEST-FORMED. It states the direction in two independent parts and derives both: byte drift, and a scope defect that could only hide a closer pair. The mechanical account of why the two distance-3 pairs went undisclosed re-derives on both legs - Ängman ~ Åhmans = 4 against Ängman ~ Åhman = 3, so the genitive kept the token out of the population; and Börje's all-token minimum is 2, held by the ordinary Swedish words Före and Varje, so the name pair at 3 sat outside a three-nearest display. The V-FINAL contract the field writes (read named_figures alongside the five paths, fold genitives, emit two minima sets) follows from the diagnosis rather than from an assertion.

justification: This unit took the heaviest round-1 evidence load in the batch - six figures failing re-derivation - and every one of the corrections re-derives, in both directions where a direction exists. The Trastkärr set is now script-emitted with its population and case policy inline and all six distances are right, including the two the gate had not challenged; Börje's barred-name table is right at both of its sites; the bands figures reproduce under the declared scope and under the two alternative scopings the field offers; the en-dash per-layer breakdown reproduces; the essä-short and LÄS-wide key censuses reproduce to the unit, and the predicate that round 1 called under-specified reproduces on the first guess, which discharges that item. Three of the corrections were self-caught rather than gate-flagged - a hand-written lift cell against an emitted one, a false '1-2 tokens in every option', and a division redone the conservative way - and one of them strengthened the conclusion it sat under rather than weakening it. The q2 rebuild closed both legs of the G-STEM kill at the root: the key no longer asserts anything roundness entails, and the geometric derivation that carried the kill has no landing option left. The only thing I could not re-derive is the coordinator-supplied '35 of 37' carried into the repair log; the unit's own staleness stamp asserts no count and is the best-formed in the batch. Pass.
